SessionRecorder

class SessionRecorder(state, config_service, session_service, session_detail_service)[source]

Bases: object

Persist the match: session row, events (details) and config.

Reads the GameState and writes through the services; it does not decide game rules. Session, configuration and detail go together: the session’s phase_reached/level_reached and the kartea_config phase/level receive the current phase/level, the same as the events recorded in the detail.

Parameters:
stateGameState

Match state (source of the recorded values).

config_servicePlayerKarteaConfigService

Player/professional lookup and recording of phase/level/session in the configuration.

session_servicePlayerKarteaSessionService

Sessions (must share the config_service session DAO, so that the session created here is recorded in kartea_config).

session_detail_servicePlayerKarteaSessionDetailService

Events (details) of the session.

Attributes:
AUTOSAVE_INTERVALfloat, class attribute

Interval (real seconds) between automatic session saves (30).

SESSION_TOTAL_BY_EVENTdict[EventType, str], class attribute

Detail event -> session total (SessionStats) it increments.

stateGameState

Match state.

config_servicePlayerKarteaConfigService

Configuration service.

session_servicePlayerKarteaSessionService

Session service.

session_detail_servicePlayerKarteaSessionDetailService

Session detail service.

current_sessionPlayerKarteaSession | None

Open session; None until the first event.

start_date, start_timestr | None

Start of the session (DATE_FORMAT / TIME_FORMAT).

last_savefloat

Time of the last session save (time.time()).

property has_session: bool

Whether a session is already open.

record(event_type, event_position=0)[source]

Record an event (opening the session on the first event).

Parameters:
event_typeEventType | str

Type of the event.

event_positionint, optional

Lane related to the event (0 when it has none).

Notes

Collision/avoidance events also add to the session totals (SessionStats), at this single point. The event gets the current date/time, phase, level and player lane.

save()[source]

Save the session row and the phase/level in the config.

The session row gets the totals up to this moment. Called at the end of each level, after every phase/level change and at the checkpoints (pause, menu choices, game exit and autosave), so that an interrupted level also reaches the session.

Notes

The configuration follows the game (advance, regress…): the next session starts where this one stopped. It is updated even when no session is open.

autosave_if_due()[source]

Save the session if AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL has passed.
